findings.detail: Issuer identity extraction is contaminated with section, instrument, rate, and date text; raw source keeps Portfolio Company separate, causing recurring issuers to miss continuity matching when terms change.

rationale: D06 is a Class 3 aggregate continuity flag. Source coverage anchors tie: the filing reports total investments at fair value of 917,425,138 for March 31, 2024, and the SOI total uses the same value. The low observed continuity metric, 20/136 = 0.1471, is not supported by the raw SOI: representative issuer rows such as Infrabuild Australia Pty Ltd and Dye & Durham Corp appear in both March 31, 2024 and December 31, 2023 schedules with issuer, instrument, rate, dates, and fair value in separate columns. The bundle sample shows extracted issuer_name values concatenating country, investment class, instrument, industry, rate, acquisition date, and maturity date into the issuer identity; term/rate changes therefore create artificial non-continuity. This is a real extraction defect, not genuine issuer turnover.
